visualCharacteristics.purpose: one view of the Lufthansa Group for Business member area, its data from lh-backends on the site's own host
traits: dashboard: greeting, dark blue tiles to the member pages, the accounts
an answer's fields as a definition list, a list of objects as a table that scrolls on a phone
loading, empty, forbidden and error states as one paragraph

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value; every row optional. The variant names the view (dashboard, fund, history, users, reports, profile, accounts). Rows override the built-in English and German texts; Fund tile / History tile / Reports tile / Users tile | link set the dashboard tiles (shown by the roles: CSF fund and history, REPORTING reports, ADMIN or KAM user management); Label <the field's words> / Value <value> (booleans: Value true / Value false) / Role <code> | text and Hide | fields shape an answer's display; Login page | link.

usage: lh-b2b /<root>/home (dashboard), fund, history, usermanagement (users), reports, profile, lhghome (accounts).
reuseGuidance: One block per member page. The endpoints per view are in render(); answers are displayed by presenter() without knowing their shape.
